avis.texte: So, I would wake up in the morning, and parts of my face would be covered with scales. I looked like a fish. I went to a nurse practitioner who specializes in skin conditions. She gave me a prescription for something that cost $400 per bottle and was not covered by insurance. I decided to look for an alternative. I asked a nurse friend who works at a nursing home for a recommendation. She said Sea Breeze would do the trick. I looked this stuff up on the internet and saw that they have been around since the early 1900's. They may have tweaked the formula a little but apparently, they have something going for them. So, I gave it a try. No more scales! It has a pleasant odor. I use it after I shave in the morning. It tingles a little but if makes my face feel good. Not everyone has the same type of skin and the same issue. So, it may not work for everyone. But, at this price it is worth a try. I'm definitely going to be a repeat customer.

avis.titre: It’s been my skin go-to for 30 years.
avis.texte: I have used Sea Breeze for 30 +years & I love it.it refreshes your skin, is gentle & cleans your skin as well removing residue from cold cream & skin products. In summer with sweaty skin, it’s a must.

My scalp was itching for no apparent reason, no dandruff. I remembered this being used in my sil hair salon a million years ago. I was surprised to see it could still be purchased. I applied it to my hair after shampooing, let it set a few minutes then rinsed. No more itching. Will not do without this.
It came in perfect condition. I've had this before and that's why I'm buying it again after I ran out. It cleans my face thoroughly without any adverse reaction. I have very sensitive skin.

I use Seabreeze for a very very long time this makes your skin feel clean and tight and you can definitely feel it clean your pores I would definitely recommend it to a friend this is the best face stuff that I have found
My teen uses this and loves it. Tried it this summer in America and swears by it 👌
Ho ricevuto il prodotto oggi, era in ritardo ma dai.. è un Pandemic! Buona.

Dieses Gesichtswasser ist der Wahnsinn. Es ist sehr viel stärker als deutsche Marken. Die große Flasche hält sehr lange. Der Geruch ist gewöhnungsbedürftig-verfliegt aber sofort wenn man eine Creme danach aufträgt. An sich benutze ich das Produkt nur abends nach dem Abschminken weil es auch nach dem normalen Waschgel noch Makeup Reste entfernt. WEnn man merkt man bekommt einen Pickel und benutzt das Gesichtswasser kommt der Pickel nicht durch sondern dieses "ich-bekomme-jetzt-bald-einen-fetten-Pickel-Gefühl" ist nach max. zwei tagen weg und es kommt auch kein Pickel. Werde ich mir wieder kaufen, es ist zwar ein langer Transportweg aber das ist ok wenn man aus den USA bestellt.

Ich liebe dieses Gesichtswasser. Es ist erfrischend, brennt nicht auf der Haut und reinigt meine Mischhaut ausgezeichnet. Seit dem ich es benutze habe ich schon wesentlich weniger Hautunreinheiten und macht meine Abendroutine perfekt. Der Preis kann sich auch sehen lassen, weil man lange damit auskommt. Ich benutze immer noch die erste Flasche die ich mir vor 4 Monate gekauft habe.

avis.titre: For that undeniably fresh clean filling
avis.texte: Seabreeze sensitive skin has always been great to clean impurities in the skin efficiently and gently. This product is a great astringent with a nice scent. Works well and is a decent value for the money as it's been doing its thing for years. This product keeps my skin clean and clear with its great smelling baby blue liquid. Deep cleaning and definitely product worth keeping on the recurring toiletry list.

It is a great product. Only giving 4 stars because it was broken.

Before I go ahead and critique the astrigent, I used to use this ALOT in high-school during the 90s. It was a staple in my beauty routine. I used this in conjunction with Noxzema back in the day. I stopped using it since the early 2000s. But I vividly remember the quality at that time and here's why I'm sad. THEY REMOVED CLOVE OIL AND EUCALYPTUS OIL FROM THE FORMULA. ITS NOT TINGLY ANYMORE. ITS STRAIGHT UP ALCOHOL WITH A MINT-ISH SENSATION, BUT NOT THE SUPER MINTY SENSATION OF THE 70S,80S AND 90S! Now the product still works. It does remove extra makeup, oil. Helps with the blackheads, a bit. But it's the PUNCH 👊 IN YOUR FACE TINGLE it was known for. Those days are gone. The company who bought Seabreeze made a decision to remove clove oil and Eucalyptus oil either to save money, or make the product more user friendly (I read somewhere their original formula was too strong and it made people avoid buying it). I'm planning to purchase clove oil and Eucalyptus oil, to experiment making my Seabreeze more into the original formula if my skin breakouts, blackheads and Comedones cannot be tamed by this new updated formula. I felt as a consumer you should know the formula has changed. Again nothing against Seabreeze! Just wished they updated their online ingredient list to reflect their new formula, found out the hard way buying it at Walmart and reading the back that those 2 prominent ingredients are no longer part of the formula!!!!

"Great for sensitive skin". Bull hockey! "Refreshing tingling feeling". This toxic waste set my face on FIRE. Day 3 and I'm still red. Lid was screwed on and bottle was shrink wrapped in some sort of nearly impregnable substance that required a knife to remove. When I removed the lid to take off the tamper seal that i assumed should have been there, there was none.
